<thought>Based on the mapped reaction provided, the retrosynthetic step replaces a para‑chloride on the phenyl ring with a tertiary amine side chain (C[NH+]4CC(F)C4). Therefore the only plausible precursor combination consists of the aryl‑chloride version of the molecule and the amine fragment. The two SMILES are:
1. COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CCl)cc3)c2N)c1
2. C[NH+]4CC(F)C4

Thus the list of possible precursor sets is a single list containing these two SMILES.</thought>
